articles.title_en: Online Corrigendum to “Social Media and Protest Participation: Evidence From Russia”

articles.abstract_en: The discourse around pay transparency has focused on partial equilibrium effects: how workers rectify pay inequities through informed renegotiation. We investigate how employers respond in equilibrium. We study a model of bargaining under two‐sided incomplete information. Our model predicts that transparency reduces the individual bargaining power of workers, leading to lower average wages. A key insight is that employers credibly refuse to pay high wages to any one worker to avoid costly renegotiations with others. When workers have low individual bargaining power, pay transparency has a muted effect. We test our model with an event‐study analysis of U.S. state‐level laws protecting the right of private sector workers to communicate salary information with their coworkers. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, transparency laws empirically lead wages to decline by approximately 2%, and wage declines are smallest in magnitude when workers have low individual bargaining power.
articles.abstract_cn: 围绕薪酬透明的讨论一直聚焦于局部均衡效应：工人如何通过知情重新谈判来纠正薪酬不平等。我们研究雇主在均衡中如何回应。我们研究了一个双边不完全信息下的讨价还价模型。我们的模型预测，透明会降低工人的个人议价能力，导致平均工资下降。一个关键见解是，雇主可信地拒绝向任何一名工人支付高工资，以避免与其他工人进行代价高昂的重新谈判。当工人的个人议价能力较低时，薪酬透明的影响会减弱。我们通过对美国州级法律的事件研究分析来检验我们的模型，这些法律保护私营部门工人与同事沟通薪资信息的权利。与我们的理论预测一致，透明法律经验上导致工资下降约2%，且当工人个人议价能力较低时，工资下降幅度最小。

articles.title_en: The Welfare Effects of Encouraging Rural–Urban Migration
articles.title_cn: 鼓励农村向城市迁移的福利效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the welfare effects of encouraging rural–urban migration in the developing world. To do so, we build and analyze a dynamic general‐equilibrium model of migration that features a rich set of migration motives. We estimate the model to replicate the results of a field experiment that subsidized seasonal migration in rural Bangladesh, leading to significant increases in migration and consumption. We show that the welfare gains from migration subsidies come from providing better insurance for vulnerable rural households rather than from correcting spatial misallocation by relaxing credit constraints for those with high productivity in urban areas that are stuck in rural areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了鼓励发展中国家农村向城市迁移的福利效应。为此，我们构建并分析了一个动态一般均衡迁移模型，该模型包含了丰富的迁移动机。我们估计模型以复制一项在孟加拉国农村补贴季节性迁移的实地实验结果，该实验显著增加了迁移和消费。我们表明，迁移补贴带来的福利收益来自于为脆弱的农村家庭提供更好的保险，而非通过放松那些被困在农村但具有高城市生产率者的信贷约束来纠正空间错配。

articles.title_en: Equilibrium Effects of Food Labeling Policies
articles.title_cn: 食品标签政策的均衡效应
articles.abstract_en: We study a regulation in Chile that mandates warning labels on products whose sugar or caloric concentration exceeds certain thresholds. We show that consumers substitute from labeled to unlabeled products—a pattern mostly driven by products that consumers mistakenly believe to be healthy. On the supply side, we find substantial reformulation of products and bunching at the thresholds. We develop and estimate an equilibrium model of demand for food and firms' pricing and nutritional choices. We find that food labels increase consumer welfare by 1.8% of total expenditure, and that these effects are enhanced by firms' responses. We then use the model to study alternative policy designs. Under optimal policy thresholds, food labels and sugar taxes generate similar gains in consumer welfare, but food labels benefit the poor relatively more.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了智利的一项法规，该法规要求糖或卡路里浓度超过特定阈值的产品必须标注警告标签。我们发现，消费者会从贴标签的产品转向未贴标签的产品——这一模式主要由消费者误认为健康的产品驱动。在供给方面，我们发现了大量的产品重新配方和在阈值处的聚集现象。我们开发并估计了一个食品需求与企业定价和营养选择的市场均衡模型。我们发现，食品标签使消费者福利增加了总支出的1.8%，并且企业的反应增强了这些效应。然后，我们利用该模型研究替代政策设计。在最优政策阈值下，食品标签和糖税在消费者福利方面产生相似的收益，但食品标签相对更有利于穷人。

articles.title_en: Financial Frictions and the Wealth Distribution
articles.abstract_en: We postulate a continuous‐time heterogeneous agent model with a financial sector and households to study the nonlinear linkages between aggregate and financial variables. In our model, the interaction between the supply of bonds by the financial sector and the precautionary demand for bonds by households produces significant endogenous aggregate risk . This risk makes the economy transition between a high‐leverage region and a low‐leverage region, which, in turn, creates state dependence in impulse responses: the same shock starting from the high‐leverage region gets propagated and amplified more than when the shock arrives when leverage is low. State dependence in impulse responses generates a time‐varying aggregate precautionary savings motive that, by moving the risk‐free rate, justifies the leverage level of the financial sector in each region. Finally, we illustrate the usefulness of neutral networks to solve for the nonlinear perceived law of motion of the model, and the importance of household heterogeneity in driving its quantitative properties.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含金融部门和家庭的连续时间异质性主体模型，以研究总量变量与金融变量之间的非线性联系。在我们的模型中，金融部门债券供给与家庭预防性债券需求之间的相互作用产生了显著的内生总体风险。这种风险使经济在高杠杆区域和低杠杆区域之间转换，进而造成脉冲响应的状态依赖性：相同的冲击，若从高杠杆区域出发，其传导和放大效应强于杠杆较低时到达的冲击。脉冲响应的状态依赖性产生了随时间变化的总体预防性储蓄动机，该动机通过影响无风险利率，证明了金融部门在各区域杠杆水平的合理性。最后，我们展示了神经网络在求解模型非线性感知运动规律方面的实用性，以及家庭异质性在驱动其定量性质中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Searching for Job Security and the Consequences of Job Loss
articles.title_cn: 寻找工作保障与失业后果
articles.abstract_en: Job loss comes with large present value earnings losses which elude workhorse models of unemployment and labor market policy. I propose a parsimonious model of a frictional labor market in which jobs differ in terms of unemployment risk and workers search off‐ and on‐the‐job. This gives rise to a job ladder with slippery bottom rungs where unemployment spells beget unemployment spells. I allow for human capital to respond to time spent out of work and estimate the framework on German Social Security data. The model captures the joint response of wages, employment, and unemployment risk to job loss which I measure empirically. The key driver of the “unemployment scar” is the loss in job security and its interaction with the evolution of human capital and, in particular, the search for better employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 失业伴随着巨大的现值收入损失，这超出了失业和劳动力市场政策的标准工作模型。我提出了一个简约的摩擦性劳动力市场模型，其中工作在工作风险方面存在差异，工人进行在职和离职搜索。这产生了一个底部阶梯滑溜的工作阶梯，失业期会引发失业期。我允许人力资本对失业时间做出反应，并在德国社会保障数据上估计该框架。该模型捕捉了工资、就业和失业风险对失业的联合反应，我对此进行了实证测量。“失业疤痕”的关键驱动因素是工作保障的丧失及其与人力资本演变，特别是寻找更好就业的相互作用。

articles.title_en: Decomposing the Growth of Top Wealth Shares
articles.title_cn: 分解顶层财富份额的增长
articles.abstract_en: What drives the dynamics of top wealth inequality? To answer this question, I propose an accounting framework that decomposes the growth of the share of aggregate wealth owned by a top percentile into three terms: a within term, which is the average wealth growth of individuals initially in the top percentile relative to the economy; a between term, which accounts for individuals entering and exiting the top percentile due to changes in their relative wealth rankings; and a demography term, which accounts for individuals entering or exiting the top percentile due to death and population growth. I obtain closed‐form expressions for each term in a wide range of random growth models. Evidence from the Forbes 400 list suggests that the between term accounts for half of the recent rise in top wealth inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 是什么驱动了顶层财富不平等的动态？为了回答这个问题，我提出了一个会计框架，将顶层百分位所拥有的总财富份额的增长分解为三个项：内部项，即初始处于顶层百分位的个体相对于经济的平均财富增长；流动项，即由于相对财富排名变化而进入和退出顶层百分位的个体；以及人口项，即由于死亡和人口增长而进入或退出顶层百分位的个体。我在广泛的随机增长模型中获得了每一项的闭式表达式。来自福布斯400榜单的证据表明，流动项解释了近期顶层财富不平等上升的一半。

articles.title_en: Relational Contracts: Public versus Private Savings
articles.title_cn: 关系契约：公共储蓄与私人储蓄
articles.abstract_en: Work on relational employment agreements often predicts low payments or termination for poor performance. The possibility of saving can, however, limit the effectiveness of monetary incentives in motivating an employee with diminishing marginal utility for consumption. We study the role of savings and their observability in optimal relational contracts. We focus on the case where players are not too patient, and hence the constant first‐best effort cannot be implemented. If savings are hidden, the relationship eventually deteriorates over time. In particular, both payments and effort decline. On the other hand, if savings are public, consumption is initially high, so the agent's savings fall over time, and effort and payments to the agent increase. The findings thus suggest how tacit agreements on consumption can forestall the deterioration of dynamic relationships in which the agent can save.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于关系型雇佣协议的研究通常预测，对于表现不佳的情况会给予低报酬或终止合同。然而，储蓄的可能性可能会限制货币激励在激励具有递减消费边际效用的员工方面的有效性。我们研究了储蓄及其可观察性在最优关系契约中的作用。我们关注参与者不太有耐心的情形，因此无法实施恒定的最优努力水平。如果储蓄是隐藏的，关系最终会随时间恶化。特别是，报酬和努力都会下降。另一方面，如果储蓄是公开的，消费最初很高，因此代理人的储蓄随时间下降，而代理人的努力和报酬则增加。因此，研究结果表明，关于消费的默契协议如何能够防止代理人可以储蓄的动态关系恶化。

articles.abstract_en: The method of synthetic controls is a fundamental tool for evaluating causal effects of policy changes in settings with observational data. In many settings where it is applicable, researchers want to identify causal effects of policy changes on a treated unit at an aggregate level while having access to data at a finer granularity. This article proposes an extension of the synthetic controls estimator that takes advantage of this additional structure and provides nonparametric estimates of the heterogeneity within the aggregate unit. The idea is to replicate the quantile function associated with the treated unit by a weighted average of quantile functions of the control units. This estimator relies on the same mathematical theory as the changes‐in‐changes estimator and can be applied in both repeated cross‐sections and panel data with as little as a single pre‐treatment period. It also provides a unique counterfactual quantile function for any type of distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 合成控制法是评估政策变化在观测数据环境下因果效应的基本工具。在许多适用该方法的场景中，研究者希望在获得更细粒度数据的同时，识别政策变化对总体层面处理单元的因果效应。本文提出了一种合成控制估计量的扩展，利用了这一额外结构，并提供了总体单元内异质性的非参数估计。其思想是通过控制单元分位数函数的加权平均来复制与处理单元相关的分位数函数。该估计量依赖于与变化-变化估计量相同的数学理论，可应用于重复横截面数据以及仅含单一预处理期的面板数据。它还为任何类型的分布提供了唯一的反事实分位数函数。

articles.title_en: Unemployment and Endogenous Reallocation Over the Business Cycle
articles.title_cn: 失业与经济周期中的内生性再配置
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the extent to which the cyclicality of occupational mobility shapes that of aggregate unemployment and its duration distribution. We document the relation between workers' occupational mobility and unemployment duration over the long run and business cycle. To interpret this evidence, we develop a multisector business cycle model with heterogenous agents. The model is quantitatively consistent with several important features of the US labor market: procyclical gross and countercyclical net occupational mobility, the large volatility of unemployment and the cyclical properties of the unemployment duration distribution, among many others. Our analysis shows that occupational mobility due to workers' changing career prospects, and not occupation‐wide differences, interacts with aggregate conditions to drive the fluctuations of the unemployment duration distribution, and the aggregate unemployment rate.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了职业流动性的周期性如何影响总体失业及其持续时间分布的周期性。我们记录了工人职业流动性与失业持续时间在长期和经济周期中的关系。为了解释这一证据，我们构建了一个包含异质性主体的多部门经济周期模型。该模型在数量上与美国劳动力市场的几个重要特征一致：顺周期的总职业流动性和逆周期的净职业流动性、失业的大幅波动以及失业持续时间分布的周期性特征等。我们的分析表明，由于工人职业前景变化而非职业间差异导致的职业流动性，与总体经济状况相互作用，驱动了失业持续时间分布和总体失业率的波动。
